tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the whole classical Islamic library (8,594 works, no scope) and get up to 10 pages as {id, title, url}; pass an id to `fetch` to read the page. This is the generic one-argument entry (the standard search/fetch pair); the scoped tools answer research questions better. Use shamela_search_librar

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one library page whole by the id `search` returned: main text, then its footnotes under their own label (the editor's words, never the author's), with book, author, printed volume/page, edition data and the shamela.ws link. Use shamela_read instead to read one body part at a time (unit "page"),

tools.name: shamela_search
tools.description:
Full-text search inside the pages (matn and footnotes) of installed books. `match` picks how the query is read:
- words (default): every word required, ranked by relevance; options add morphology, wildcards, chronological sort. An all-words miss retries with fewer words (relaxed_min_match).
- phrase

tools.name: shamela_read
tools.description:
Read an installed book's text and structure by internal ids. `unit`:
- page (default): one page_id → body (author's matn), foot (editor's footnotes), printed page label, prev/next page ids, enclosing headings.
- range: up to 20 consecutive pages from start_page_id, each with text, footnotes, printed

tools.description: Citations. mode=citation (default): build one for a book, optionally a page and quoted text — Shamela's copy format, short inline, full with death year, or BibTeX/RIS. tools.name: shamela_lookup_quran
tools.description:
Qur'an text. mode=search (default): find verses by Arabic words, typed in إملائي spelling or pasted in Uthmani rasm; words ANDed, results in mushaf order (aya_id 1–6236), not relevance. Zero hits usually means a misspelling: drop a word or use options.wildcards.
mode=aya: fetch verses you can alread

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "shamela_find" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
